taxes.summary: On her campaign issues page she calls for changing a tax system she describes as punishing working families while giving handouts to the wealthy and corporations, and for closing corporate tax shelters and loopholes to increase revenue for public schools.
taxes.short: Supports closing corporate tax loopholes; changing the tax system.

abortion.summary: Her campaign issues page states she will protect a woman's right to choose and stand up for access to women's health care, including birth control.
abortion.short: Supports abortion rights and access to birth control.

education.summary: Her campaign issues page calls for fully and equitably funding public schools, holding charter schools to the same transparency and accountability standards, expanding pre-K, full-day kindergarten and STEM and arts programs, and reducing or eliminating standardized testing.
education.short: Supports fully funding public schools; charter accountability; less standardized testing.

healthcare.summary: Her campaign issues page states she will work to bring down costs for premiums, co-pays and prescription drugs, stop the denial of coverage for pre-existing conditions, support safe staffing limits for nurses, and make addiction and mental health services affordable.
healthcare.short: Supports lowering drug and premium costs; protecting pre-existing conditions.

energy.summary: Her campaign issues page cites the state constitutional right to clean air and water and says she opposes pollution from oil companies and other polluters.
energy.short: Supports clean air and water; opposes pollution from polluters.

guns.summary: Her campaign issues page supports a background check with every gun purchase, a minimum age for gun purchases and child-access-prevention policies, banning bump stocks and limiting magazine sizes, and requiring a permit for concealed carry; it states she opposes arming teachers who are not law enforcement professionals.
guns.short: Supports background checks, concealed-carry permits; opposes arming teachers.
